caption: A riderless skateboard rolls past a streetlamp at night, and its shadow swings around it as it passes under the light.

sa.check: A skateboard with no rider is present.
A lit streetlamp stands nearby and it is night.
The skateboard's shadow is visible and changes as the board passes the lamp.
The board passes close to or under the lamp.
The scene is dark apart from the lamp light.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side of the board away from the lamp: behind it while approaching, short beneath it under the lamp, stretching ahead once past.
pc.fail: The shadow points toward the lamp; or stays fixed on one side of the board as it passes; or the shadow does not move with the board; or no shadow is cast under a lit lamp.

pc.expect: The board rolls in a straight line at a steady, gently slowing pace.
pc.fail: The board speeds up on the flat with nothing pushing it; or turns or reverses by itself; or hops.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the board's outline, deck and wheels, and stays attached at the wheels.
pc.fail: The shadow detaches from the wheels; or has a different shape from the board; or splits into two shadows under one lamp.

pc.expect: The shadow moves only as the board moves; the lamp stays lit and steady.
pc.fail: The shadow swings while the board is stationary; or the lamp goes out or moves; or the shadow changes length with the board standing still.

pc.expect: One board with its wheels and one shadow; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the pavement.
pc.fail: The board vanishes or duplicates; or a rider appears from nowhere; or wheels vanish; or the board passes through the lamp post.

pc.expect: The deck's colour and graphics, the lamp and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The deck changes colour; or the lamp changes colour; or the street markings shift.
